Very good vegan curry
Feb 2020
I went for dinner there last night and I could have done a lot worse than choosing this restaurant. I had a very flavorful coconut milk curry with tofu and vegetables. They added peanuts to it which added some crunch to the dish and which I found quite tasty. The veggies were onions, potatoes and carrots (maybe a slight lack of variety there...), plus plenty of tofu. It comes with your choice of either rice or bread. The atmosphere is pleasant and relaxed, the terrace is far enough from the road so you don’t get too much of the noise and pollution. Despite the restaurant being rather large and busy, the overworked waiters were doing a great job delivering orders and bills and responding to requests in a timely manner. I barely had to wait for my food and it was a very enjoyable evening. Prices are very reasonable too (115’000 VND for my curry)! 
Being vegan, I found several dishes here to accommodate my requirements but I saw that they also have a live grill with various fish, seafood and meats on display.

Hands down best restaurant on the island
Dec 2019 • Friends
What makes this restaurant so special? It’s family run with amazing service, fresh seafood grilled to order, transparent prices (no surprises here, no scams, no up charges because you’re a tourist), homemade Vietnamese rice wine (150 k per bottle / about $7 dollars)!! and most importantly delicious food at an affordable price!! We ordered a full grilled fish Cooked in garlic which was to die for and mouth watering. We also got the vegetarian spring rolls, my friend and I really thought this stole the show and last we got rice and curries which were delicious and authentic. Seeing other plates pass by, I could have eaten a second meal and then never eaten again for a month because of my satisfaction and admiration. The family who runs it is authentic, nice and very friendly. They do a good honest job and represent phu Quoc and the Vietnamese island well. Outdoor seating available too! Try their rice wine for an affordable and unique Vietnamese experience. I attached the photo of the bottle brewed in Vietnam!

Best Pho Bo of our lives!
Jul 2019 • Couples
This restaurant is the hidden gem of Phu Quoc island! We just arrived in Vietnam and our first meal was at this fine establishment. We stumbled across it because it was right in front of a hostel and we were just looking for a quick meal. We did not expect to have the best Pho Bo we have ever tasted in our lives. The broth was exceptional and compared to the Pho we eat in the states we will never be able to find comparable Pho Bo when we go back. The owner was very friendly and when we told her it was the best Pho Bo and that we would most certainly be back she sadly told us that they were closing for vacations the following day :( Overall, it was the best Pho Bo we have ever tasted and I highly recomme d it.
